Spotlight: Idaho 4yo cost 4,500euros as a foal and 15,000euros as a 3yo; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Con's Roc (useful 2m6f/3m chase), Lady Kk (2m5f-2m7f hurdle/chase), Rock On Cassie (2m4f hurdle) and Snowrocco (2m7f/3m hurdle); placed on last of four point-to-point runs in the spring for J P Berry; probably best watched on hurdles debut.

RaceName: Solar Generation Maiden Hurdle
Spotlight: Half-sister to several winners, notably high-class hurdler/chaser up to 3m4f Yala Enki; returned from lengthy absence to finish a clear second in 2m6f Limerick mares' maiden hurdle in April (soft) before contesting bumpers on better ground, chasing home an all-the-way winner in 2m2f Downpatrick mares' contest, not so good over 2m4f at Wexford; this looks a fine opportunity (Jack Kennedy's only ride on the card).

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Group 1 Dewhurst and Group 2 Champagne entry; Dark Angel colt who made a winning debut at Newcastle (6f, AW; 4-5) 19 days ago, pulling around 4l clear with the runner-up; pedigree suggests this extra furlong will be no issue but stall 13 doesn't make life easy under a penalty.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dubawi colt; third foal; dam 7f 2yo winner (RPR 94), half-sister to 1m4f Group 2 winner Qilin Queen, out of 1m4f winning half-sister to Irish 1,000 Guineas winner Nightime (dam of multiple Group 1 winner Ghaiyyath); his dam went close here on her debut and she's interesting on her debut for a stable that won this in 2024.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten 20l when last of six on his debut at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) in May and beat only one rival home at Lingfield (7f, AW) last month; best watched.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 70,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Capital Theory (9.4f-1m5f including AW; RPR 96), Senesi (1m; 82), Palifico (5f AW; 79) and Sahana (7f AW/1m turf; 74); dam Group-placed 1m 2yo winner (103), out of half-sister to Arc runner-up White Muzzle; makes appeal on debut.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Mrs M C Sweeney & Alan King
Spotlight: 80,000gns yearling, 100,000gns breeze-up buy; colt by Sea The Stars; sixth foal; brother to 9.4f AW/1m2f turf winner Inquisition (RPR 80); half-brother to 7f-8.5f winner Nuance (including 2yo/Qatar); dam 1m-10.5f winner (including Group 3; 110), half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Veracious; pedigree suggests he may be one for slightly longer trips but he's interesting.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Colt by Nathaniel; eighth foal; brother to French 1m1f/1m4f winner Born With Wings (RPR 100), closely related to 7f-1m1f winner Majoris (including GB 2yo/HK; 95), half-brother to winners Dream Of Stars (1m2f/1m4f; 93) and Rasaasy (1m4f AW; 81); dam placed 1m1f (66); one to monitor in the betting.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 32,000gns foal, 50,000gns yearling; gelding by Perfect Power; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Hebridean Nomad (1m 2yo/1m4f AW; RPR 77) and Giava Dream (French 1m3f); dam 1m winner (67), half-sister to Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner Mon Cadeaux and useful 6f/7f winner Indian Creak; his half-brother won here over 1m on his second start.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Kingman colt; second foal; dam 7f/8.6f 2yo winner (including AW; RPR 89), half-sister to Group 1 winners Bluestocking (1m2f/1m4f including Arc) and Qirat (1m Sussex Stakes), out of 1m Group 1 winner; makes plenty of appeal on pedigree for a stable that has won this twice in recent years, including with Qirat in 2023.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 75,000gns yearling, 80,000gns breeze-up buy; colt by Too Darn Hot; third foal; dam 1m AW 2yo winner (RPR 94), half-sister to winners Total Commitment (useful 6f/7f including 2yo) and Crystallium (7f 2yo), is granddaughter of Fillies' Mile winner Crystal Music; stable also runs Hoshi.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 22,000euros yearling, 46,000gns breeze-up purchase; colt by Gregorian; second foal; half-brother to Italian 5f/6f 2yo winner Lion In The Jungle; dam 5f 2yo winner (RPR 73), half-sister to winners Rufus King (useful 6f-1m including 2yo) and Papa Power (1m2f), out of Listed-placed 1m winner.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Colt by Rumble Inthejungle; third foal; dam Listed-placed 5f/6f 2yo winner (RPR 92), half-sister to Graded stakes-placed 5f-7.5f winner Jeanie B, out of Listed-placed 5f/6f winner; has a speedy pedigree.

RaceName: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 60,000euros yearling; filly by Hello Youmzain; fourth foal; unraced dam closely related to 1m2f Group 1 winner Lily Of The Valley, half-sister to 5.5f/6f Listed winner Calbuco, out of maiden half-sister to useful/prolific 5f-1m2f winner Hurricane Spirit; look out for market clues on her debut.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Useful 6yo who gained a somewhat overdue hurdling success at Wexford (2m4f, good) last month and also made all at Cartmel (2m6f, good) a fortnight later; ought to give this a good shot under 12lb penalty.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Fairly useful Flat stayer who drew clear to score by over 6l at Aintree (2mf, good) in May and is now 2-3 over hurdles; has the big 12lb penalty here and Sean Bowen is replaced by an amateur but could be seen to even better effect over this longer trip; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Listed Flat winner as a 2yo and showed the benefit of his winter wind op when scoring in good style over hurdles at Stratford (2m2f, good to firm) and here (2m, good) this summer; tries a new trip today; big player.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: 1-19 over hurdles, the win gained from the front at Sedgefield (2m4f, good) in April; below that form when fifth of six in recent 2m Uttoxeter handicap, though, and others in this field have much more potential.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Irish point winner; placed on first two hurdling starts for Seamus Mullins (2m1f/2m2f) and showed improved form when easily making all by 8l at Fontwell (2m3f, good) in May; needs to make further progress for new stable (same owner) but that's possible.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Just held on to win Market Rasen handicap over nearly 2m6f (if additional yardage is included) last month, opening his hurdling account at the tenth attempt; evidently in good nick, but not favoured by the weights on this return to novice company.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: 0-7 in Irish points; won good-ground Charing maiden on British debut in December but pulled up all three starts since; can only be watched on rules debut.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Well-held 66-1 shot when last of three finishers on hurdling debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; first-time cheekpieces) in June; passed over.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Runner-up in good-ground C&D handicaps on last two outings, latterly behind Phantom Gold five weeks ago; 12lb better off with that rival today but has a bit to find with some of the others.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Did not get competitive in first two hurdle races (both 2m); upped in trip today; stable has much more obvious chance with Square d'Alboni.

RaceName: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hdl Qual') (GBB)
Spotlight: Ended five-race Irish Flat career with 1m4f maiden win in October and has performed well in three novice/maiden hurdles for new stable this season, most notably when winning by 10l at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good) two runs ago; can be in the shake-up if suited by this new trip.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled up in a staying handicap at Galway; her previous course win (over a longer trip than this) was achieved despite an untidy round of jumping; needs to be more fluent.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: New headgear combination did the trick when he won a 2m6f handicap at Limerick in May; up 8lb, may be capable of making further progress.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has shown promise at this venue on his last three starts; fourth in a claimer on final start for previous yard; well backed when third in a higher-grade handicap than this on stable debut, when wrong at the weights; second here 13 days ago; fair chance he can prevail in a rematch with third-placed Georginas Jet.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Placed in three handicaps last August at up to 2m6f; 10l winner over this trip at Downpatrick in June; held when favourite on next two starts; very closely matched with Phoenix Arizona on running here last time; should be thereabouts.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 1-34 over hurdles and 0-12 over fences; hard to be confident with that profile, though she has made the frame in five of her last six outings; career highlight when beating Katie's Kasper over 3m at Kilbeggan in May.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Sixth of 18 at Punchestown in May (2m, good to yielding) represents her best form; in a top stable and still early days; improvement is not out of the question.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in a point, bumper and three maiden hurdles; tongue-tie and cheekpieces on for handicap debut; up against it.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Had a long period on the sidelines; shaped quite well in handicap hurdles at Punchestown and Downpatrick before a career-best when second at Wexford 12 days ago.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Looked like a possible future winner when second to Love Like This at Kilbeggan in June; unplaced twice since then; hard to be confident now.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 18-race maiden over hurdles; C&D third 13 months ago was one of her better efforts but well below that level since returning from a break, including over fences; Darragh O'Keeffe sticks with her despite a moderate Wexford run; first-time tongue-tie.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden was placed on a few occasions when trained by Tony Martin; flopped at Downpatrick ten days ago; her previous run at the same venue was respectable, beaten around 10l in third and in front of Sekakarma who improved on that last time.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Cheaply acquired from Britain, very poor form; Gordon Elliott may find the key to him; market may provide a hint as to what is expected.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Out of depth in novice events lately and handicap form offers little or no encouragement.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden pointer; 0-17 over hurdles, yet to display winning potential, three moderate runs this term; towards the rear at Wexford on latest.

RaceName: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Poor sequence of chase attempts continued last time, when pulled up at Roscommon; fair hurdles run at Killarney in July; 1-27 hurdles record is a significant negative.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Bumper winner at Huntingdon last October; fair efforts in two starts on the Flat, finishing fourth of 13 at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) and fifth of 14 at Southwell (1m4f, AW); the latter start has been well franked by the winner but this 4yo may be of more interest in handicaps.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Brother to 1m7f hurdle winner Yosemite Gold; showed ability when fourth of 11 on his debut at Brighton (1m, good to soft) in October 2024 but absent and gelded since; has left James Tate and steps up in trip with the hood applied for his yard debut; best watched.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Hinted at promise on her debut at Catterick (1m4f, good) in October but she was well beaten here over 1m3f last month; this 4yo now steps back up in trip with better needed.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dual hurdle winner at around 2m and she went close on her Flat debut at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm; 6-5) three weeks ago; the winner has since been beaten in a handicap but this filly is open to progress in this sphere, particularly now stepping up in trip.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Tailed off on his debut at Sandown (7f, good) and returned from over a year off (gelded in the interim) with a never-dangerous seventh of 12 over 1m3f here in a race won by an impressive newcomer; handicaps may be more suitable.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dam US 1m turf winner; missed the break slightly but made some eyecatching late progress into sixth on his debut over 1m3f here (20-1) two weeks ago; the third has won since and this colt looks a likely improver over this longer trip.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Missed the break and ran green on his debut at Windsor in June, and he was beaten 40l when down the field over 1m3f here two weeks ago (behind Westender); may yet do better but others have stronger claims.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Built on his debut effort when third of seven at Ffos Las (1m2f, good) in June and, despite being beaten at odds-on, ran well when runner-up at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago, pulling 11l clear of the rest; stepping up to 1m4f should suit and he's a leading contender on his AW debut.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Hooded for both starts; failed to beat a rival on his debut at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) in December and faded into tenth of 14 at Southwell (1m4f) last time on his first start for 231 days; stall 12 isn't ideal and his pedigree suggests shorter trips will suit.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Dam German 1m4f winner; sent off 22-1 when last of four on his debut at Haydock (1m4f, good to firm; beaten 23l) in April and now switches to the AW on his first start since; a big step forward is needed but the market may be informative.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Shaped with promise when second of eight behind a subsequent winner at Ffos Las (1m2f, soft; 28-1) two months ago and has been off since; she's a half-sister to a 1m4f AW winner and she should be suited by stepping up in trip on her AW debut; contender.

RaceName: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (For Horses In Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten a neck at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) on her second start and took another step forward when second of eight at Goodwood (1m2f, good to firm) next time; wasn't at that level on her handicap debut at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) last month but has claims returned to a novice if seeing out this longer trip.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Fair Flat racer who launched hurdling career with two fairly promising 2m runs this season; took a backward step here last time but moves up in trip for this handicap hurdle debut and could be boosted by the refitted cheekpieces (he had a good record in headgear on the Flat).

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Dual chase winner last year; signed off with two poor runs in the autumn but was respectable fifth of 13 over C&D (good) off his lower hurdle mark when returning last month; not out of this if that run brought him on.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: 0-15 over hurdles and inconsistent when trained in Ireland but her second of 11 at Sligo (2m4f, good to yielding) in the autumn was a good effort; makes stable debut after 284-day absence; market may guide.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
OwnerName: DL Adams, JA Adams & G McPherson
Spotlight: Won over 2m3f on hurdle debut in April 2025 but generally disappointing since; always behind in 2m7f handicap here on latest outing six weeks ago; drops back in trip with blinkers tried today.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Quirky customer who returned to form with come-from-behind win on last month's stable debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; first-time hood); remains a tricky horse to predict but this 7lb higher mark ought to be manageable.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Kept on for respectable third over C&D (good) four weeks ago and remains on a workable mark but has 1-40 career strike-rate and others appeal more for win purposes.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Soundly beaten on stable/handicap debut at Ffos Las (2m4f, good) in April but was given a wind op soon afterwards and remains unexposed; well worth keeping an eye on in the betting.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Outran 50-1 odds when third over C&D (good) last month, his third start for Sarah-Jayne Davies, but needs a better performance today and his overall profile remains unconvincing.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Placed in three of her five handicaps, most recently when clear second of six under Sophie Carter at Stratford (2m6f, good to firm) last month; competes off same mark here; can make her presence felt again.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
Spotlight: Struggled in four novice/maiden hurdles last year and was beaten nearly 33l when 9-4 second favourite for last month's stable/handicap debut; needs significant improvement over this new trip but it will be interesting to see whether he's strong in the betting again.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Lost form after gaining a first win at Naas last year (2m3f) until much improved on second start for Conor O'Dwyer over same trip at Kilbeggan last month, coming from off the pace for ready 5.5l success (good); strong chance he'll get this longer trip, 9lb rise to contend with.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won Galway 3yo maiden last autumn and back to form in C&D handicap 13 days ago, relishing longer trip to win going away under a patient ride; 8lb rise but can go well.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Took a keen hold in defeat in maiden hurdles at Clonmel and Tramore; settled better but still found one too good on his return to Tramore in May before fading badly on handicap debut at Galway last month (2m); return to longer trip should suit.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Had run well several times in defeat before finally off the mark 11 days ago in 2m4f Wexford handicap, appreciating good ground to win going away in beating a strong favourite (pair clear); 5lb rise looks quite lenient, so major player if ground remains in his favour.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Mickey D's Bus Tangara Five Syndicate
Spotlight: Lightly raced for Henry de Bromhead but she signed off for that yard with a maiden win at Clonmel (2m3f, soft; sold on for £10,000); reluctant to race on yard debut at Galway last month, so caution advised.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Might have won on her handicap debut at Cork but for some interference (2m4f, good); unable to get competitive back to 2m at Galway, so return to longer trip a positive and don't rule out.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: M R D Fleming & G Bruce & J P Ryan & Miss G Ryan
Spotlight: Up front throughout when winning 2m2f mares' handicap here last month (good); similar tactics employed in 2m2f novices since, third at Ballinrobe and weakened badly when last of 5 here; steps up in trip now.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 13-race maiden but has shaped well on a few occasions, most notably when fourth at Leopardstown (2m2f, soft) in March; not at same level of late, never counting at Galway latest; much more needed.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Limerick win last year (for Aengus King) her sole success, but two good runs of late in 2m1f handicaps, clear of remainder when beaten 1l at Killarney and stayed on late into third at Cork; yet to convince over this far.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Not the easiest to win with, as her 2-31 record over hurdles illustrates, but both wins have been over this C&D, including off this mark last summer; penultimate Wexford third was a good effort, 3m2f may have been too far last time; place claims back at optimum trip.

RaceName: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Off the mark at 28th attempt when landing 2m3f Kilbeggan handicap last month, allowed to slip the field and win unchallenged; no such leeway at Galway since, weakening between final two flights; third over C&D last month, so trip of no concern.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: The most recent of his five wins came in the 2024 Lincoln on soft; left the impression his first start for 324 days was needed when sixth of 13 at Thirsk (1m, good) on his stable debut in May but this C&D winner has been off again since.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Often front-runner but not when he won twice on the AW last August, including here over 7f; 8lb above the most recent success but he gave it a good go from the front when third at Ayr (1m, good) 11 days ago; has to be considered.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Won twice on the AW in December, including in a Southwell handicap off a 6lb lower mark than today's, and posted an improved effort when third of nine in a conditions event over this C&D in March; disappointed on turf at Epsom (1m2f, soft) when last seen 74 days ago but makes appeal back on the AW in first-time cheekpieces having been gelded.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Dual AW winner last November and made a winning handicap debut at Newmarket (1m, good) in April; lost her unbeaten record in the 1,000 Guineas next time and then was well beaten in the Sandringham at Royal Ascot; last of six over 1m2f at Newmarket last month but a case can be made now that she drops back to 1m on her return to the AW.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Placed in his first three starts (8.5f/1m) and posted an improved effort when winning a five-runner race on his handicap debut at Hamilton (8.5f, good; first start since being gelded) last month; up 4lb but he's related to AW winners and remains open to progress after just four starts.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Fifth in the Convivial Maiden at York last August when trained by John & Sean Quinn but couldn't build on that on his stable debut at Redcar (7f, good to soft) next time and was tailed off at Pontefract (1m2f, good) in April; has since been gelded and has cheekpieces applied for his AW/handicap debut.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Caused a 40-1 surprise when winning in first-time blinkers at Sandown (1m2f, good) in June and backed that up when caught on the post at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW); well drawn and there's no obvious reason why he can't go well.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: Doubled his tally when narrowly winning over 1m at Newcastle last month and followed up with another narrow AW success here over 7f in first-time cheekpieces two weeks ago; they are now discarded but he's shortlisted off this 4lb higher mark.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div I)
Spotlight: 1m AW winner in France last December but she's struggled since; last of ten over this C&D a week ago and has plenty to prove.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Regressive 9yo who has modest strike-rate in recent years and returned from break with two underwhelming runs in July (2m4f/2m7f); revival needed.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Won fast-ground Stratford bumper by wide margin in May and has made the frame on both hurdling starts since (2m2f/2m); makes handicap debut from what looks a realistic mark and could still have potential.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Ex-Irish 7yo; 0-16 over hurdles but made promising stable debut at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good; first-time tongue-tie) last month, keeping on for third; not yet fully exposed over this sort of trip; shortlisted.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Arrested decline when third over C&D (good) on last month's hurdle return and has possibilities if in the right mood again but has become far too inconsistent to rely upon.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Tailed off on chasing debut in the autumn and also ran poorly when reappearing last month; might be happier now back over hurdles and has slipped to a good mark but others have much less to prove; swaps cheekpieces for refitted visor.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Made favourite for stable debut at Warwick (2m, good) in May but found things happening too quickly and was a never-dangerous fourth; moves back up in trip here, though, and may yet come good for Ben Pauling.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: 0-10 over hurdles but won a small-field point in the spring and bettered her low-key rules return when rallying second at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good) last month; no surprise if she features.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: Much more competitive since switched to handicaps for last two runs, more recently when second (albeit no match for winner) at Stratford (2m2f, good to firm) in June; upped in trip again here; likely contender.

RaceName: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div II)
Spotlight: A well-beaten 66-1 shot in his first two handicaps (both 2m); needs combination of new trip and tongue-tie to prompt massive improvement.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Two wins in 2023 for Gordon Elliott on soft and heavy ground; has run four times since joining Arthur Moore; has made the frame in two starts over fences; concerning that his two runs over hurdles have not been of similar standard.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Solid placed maiden form on good ground in the first half of last season; struggled in testing conditions later, including on handicap debut at Cork in December; 33-1 winner at Killarney last month on first run after a break, runner-up Koeur A Prendre has advertised the form; deserves to be a leading fancy.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Modest 2-29 jumps strike rate (hurdles and fences combined), placed nine times; produced a fair effort over fences at Wexford last month; below that level over hurdles at Ballinrobe last week.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: John J Cullen & Michael C Barrett
Spotlight: All three hurdle wins have come at this venue at 2m4f and 3m2f on decent ground; best run this year when just failing to get up over C&D last month (good); found the competition too hot at Galway; now blinkered for the first time after a tame effort here 13 days ago.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Not a bad effort when fifth on handicap debut at Wexford in May, beaten 8l in fifth; made most when second in a 2m6f maiden at Ballinrobe last month; this looks tougher but could feature with a bit of improvement.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: A dual C&D winner, his trainer's local track; last year's form also included a second placing behind Cornmarket over C&D; probably needed the run here in May, and was much improved when winning in June; up 5lb for that; deserves respect.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Second on this card last year; poor form in three points last October/November; jumped poorly and pulled up on return to hurdling at Kilbeggan in April; back to form when winning for Sam Curling in first-time blinkers over C&D in May; soft ground may have harmed his cause on stable debut at Roscommon.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won 2m7f Clonmel handicap last October off a lowly 73; poor on return at Cork but won again back at Clonmel in June, left in the lead by a faller two out; coped admirably with a 7lb rise when scoring at Cork and ran creditably off this mark when fifth in a competitive Galway festival handicap.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 1-28 over hurdles, that sole win was achieved in this race last year; struggled here last month in a race in which Cornmarket was second; much more like it when chasing home easy winner Strong Contender at Wexford; could go close now

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a 2m4f Wexford handicap last year; lost form until posting an encouraging third of 15 at Bellewstown in April (3m, yielding); reported in season when missing an engagement in June.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Durable veteran has won twice at this venue; back in form at Kilbeggan recently after a dismal spell that saw him fail to complete in four consecutive races; eight-time winner remains capable when on song.

RaceName: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Now on the upgrade after a low-key start to her career; stepped up on the form of her first two handicap starts when trouncing Tango Theatre (last year's winner of this event) over 3m at Wexford 12 days ago; up 9lb, can remain competitive.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
OwnerName: Cottier, Racing Breaks & Old Gold Racing
Spotlight: Back to something approaching his best this summer, winning handicaps at Newcastle (1m) and here (7f) on his last two starts; well drawn to attack but a 5lb penalty could scupper his hat-trick bid.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Won twice in France; three solid efforts since joining the Gosdens, the latest in a 7f handicap at Newmarket 19 days ago; dam was a C&D winner so there could be more to come on this AW debut.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Two wins last winter, including a C&D handicap off 4lb lower; sent off favourite for his return from six months off at Newcastle (1m) last month but shaped as though the run was needed; Billy Loughnane retains the ride and he still has time to do better.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with a pair of AW wins, the second coming over C&D off 5lb lower; the handicapper has been in command this year but he's not discounted back on AW.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Won twice at around 1m on turf last year; ended that campaign with two lesser efforts and he hasn't found his best in three runs this year; opposable despite his slipping mark.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Won a maiden (7f, good) and a novice (1m, AW) as a 2yo; unplaced in three handicaps this year but slipping down the weights; too soon to write him off.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: AW winner (1m) last September; his form dipped at York 40 days ago but he had been in good form earlier in the year; each-way shout.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Didn't have to improve on his 2yo form to win a novice at Lingfield (1m, AW) in February; beaten in three handicaps since but he is slipping down the weights.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div II)
Spotlight: Modest form in four runs for George Boughey last year, failing to improve on his handicap debut (1m) last October; sold for 10,000gns later that month and gelded; only of interest if backed on his belated stable debut.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Six-time Flat winner; opened account over hurdles at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good; refitted cheekpieces) in May, after a break, and ran at least as well there three weeks later; pulled up at Newton Abbot in June but spreading a plate during the race might excuse that; considered.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Value Racing - Back In The Bay
Spotlight: Can front-run; did well in May-July 2025; although well beaten, latest start (chase debut) was at least a step back in that direction; probably needs overall improvement stepping up from about 2m4f.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Led on the post in a good-ground Perth bumper in April, after a long layoff; comparable form since in his three starts over hurdles but handicap debut (Uttoxeter extended 2m4f) last time didn't yield improvement, which will be needed here with another major step up in trip.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Worked her way back to peak form and scored by just over 4l at Uttoxeter (near 3m, good) in June; ran poorly over that same C&D last month, however.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won maiden at Uttoxeter (2m7f, good) last September but has lost her way; tried chasing on last two starts; blinkers replace cheekpieces.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won over fences at Warwick (3m, good; 2lb higher today) in May but backward steps in his two starts since, despite market prominence; now has first hurdle race since November 2024 and cheekpieces return in place of the recent visor.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 4-10 under Sean Bowen, under whom he was well held four times this year before winning over C&D (good) in July on latest outing; up 7lb and the champion jockey turns elsewhere this time.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won twice over fences within a week last December; some minor honours since and edging back down the weights for this first hurdle race since February 2025 but trying this longer trip on penultimate start resulted in his worst recent performance; 10lb claimer is recruited.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual Irish point winner; launched chasing career with underwhelming runs on last three starts (3m/3m2f) and has managed no better than fourth in his six races under rules; he's now 10lb lower than on handicap debut, though, and a visor replaces the usual cheekpieces.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Almost a year off before this March; has not matched earlier promise in this year's five races, switched to handicapping for last three; appeared over C&D last two and made most when connections turned to blinkers last time but his third of ten that day was a well-beaten one; now tries a visor.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Runner-up on handicap debut here (2m4f, good) in July 2025; struggled in his next five starts but went down the weights and took advantage from the front in a six-runner C&D race (good; by a nose, with Ikigai Star third and Final Entry fourth) five weeks ago; back up 2lb but a player if he can back up that effort.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won over 2m4f here in May and over C&D four weeks ago, both on good ground and they were the only two races in which he's been ridden by Sean Bowen; raised another 7lb after doing it well last time but this 4yo remains lightly raced over this sort of trip, which seemed to suit him so well that day.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Last won at Huntingdon (2m3f, good) in May 2025; while not so good over the last year, he has gone down the weights and third of six to The Great Escape over C&D (his first run beyond 2m5f) last time gives him a place chance.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Fourth in maiden here (2m, good) last July but safely held in handicaps on all five starts since, including once at 2m6f; wore cheekpieces four starts back and again today, plus new tongue-tie; needs to turn a big corner.

RaceName: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has struggled badly on all four starts; moves up from 2m4f; 10lb wrong at the weights in this second handicap.

RaceName: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race
Spotlight: Westerner gelding is second foal of a placed hurdler, a sister to winner Montys Meadow (useful bumper/2m hurdle/2m4f chase), family of Grand National winner Monty's Pass; last of 8 on last month's Killarney debut, having been short of room before home turn; probably best watched for now.

RaceName: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race
Spotlight: E15,000 3yo; third foal; half-brother by Kew Gardens to 2m7f hurdle winner Embrace The Day; dam won on the Flat at two and was also a hurdle/chase winner; okay debut run at Roscommon early this month without landing a blow; more needed.

RaceName: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race
Spotlight: Half-brother to winners Blakey Boy (2m4f-3m2f hurdle/chase) and Knocknagoran Lady (2m6f/3m1f hurdle); dam from the family of Grand National winner Rule The World; didn't count on last month's Galway debut when a 100-1 shot; may need more time.

RaceName: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race
Spotlight: Behind throughout on recent Roscommon debut; blinkers now tried but can only be watched.

RaceName: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race
Spotlight: Order Of St George gelding; unraced dam is related to several useful bumper and hurdle performers, out of smart bumper/2m-3m hurdle winner Refinement; late headway on last month's Wexford debut suggests there is more to come; could go well.

RaceName: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race
Spotlight: Gelding by For Fun cost 25,000euros as a 3yo; half-brother to French 2m1f/2m2f hurdle winner Le Roi Loth; dam French 2m1f hurdle/2m3f chase winner, half-sister to French 2m1f/2m4f hurdle winner Saintrac; top yard had a couple of bumper winners at Tramore last week, obvious player on debut.

RaceName: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race
Spotlight: Feel Like Dancing filly; dam point winner, half-sister to bumper/2m hurdle winner On The Wild Side, out of useful 2m hurdler; promising debut second at Wexford 11 days ago (behind a Willie Mullins-trained winner) despite running green; major player.

RaceName: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race
Spotlight: Harzand half-sister to winners Minx Tiara (useful 2m-2m6f hurdle/chase) and Dolly Watkins (2m5f hurdle); dam 1m4f winner (RPR 73); market best guide on debut.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div III)
Spotlight: His second of 11 over C&D (wore cheekpieces) on reappearance in March was a new high and he bettered that when landing soft-ground Yarmouth handicap (1m) in first-time blinkers in June; off since and no headgear for this stable debut (same owners) but he still commands respect.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div III)
Spotlight: Defied a penalty to win Tapeta novice (7f) in September and it was a career best when landing Lingfield event (7f, Polytrack) last Tuesday; carries a 6lb penalty but that was just his second handicap and further progress could be on the cards; player.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div III)
Spotlight: Two wins from ten starts over C&D include a success in April off 3lb lower; didn't look in a great mood at Ascot last time but he still ran well to finish fairly close fourth; not ruled out.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div III)
Spotlight: Five of his six wins have come on AW, including C&D; last won at Southwell (1m, Tapeta) in January; not so good on turf of late but he's dangerously handicapped if the switch back to AW prompts a revival.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div III)
Spotlight: 2-2 on AW; won at Lingfield (1m, Polytrack) on his debut in April and scored again over that C&D when taking a novice last month; carries plenty of potential into this handicap debut and Billy Loughnane retains the ride.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div III)
Spotlight: Course regular who won this race last year off 4lb lower; won again over C&D in January and secured a third success when bagging Lingfield handicap (7f, Polytrack) in April; now just 1lb higher after three lesser efforts and he's not readily dismissed.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div III)
Spotlight: Could be encouraging that his only win for Andrew Balding came on his sole start here (7f novice) but he left that stable after a poor show at Chester last July and it's been a similar story in two outings for this yard; only of interest if lively in the betting.

RaceName: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (London Mile Series Qualifier) (Div III)
Spotlight: Two wins over C&D but his mark suffered after a comfortable win at Sandown (1m, good) around a year ago; handicapper's releasing his grip and last time's fifth at Ffos Las was a step in the right direction, however; might go well.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
OwnerName: The Old Etonian Racing Syndicate II
Spotlight: Off the mark in Lingfield handicap (7f, Polytrack) in May and it was a similar effort when third on turf at Newbury (1m, good to soft) one month later; couldn't match that over 7f at Ayr last time but he's not ruled out back on AW.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: His form started to wobble in novices but his best run came over C&D in that sphere and the return to this venue and added blinkers steadied the ship when 50-1 second (1m; drawn widest) on his handicap debut last Monday; has had issues at the start but the draw has been kinder this time and he warrants consideration from the same mark.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: Patchy form in three qualifying runs for Adrian Keatley last year and he was beaten a long way when last of 11 on his reappearance and handicap/stable debut at Haydock (6f; hooded) in April; goes up a furlong for his first bash at AW.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: Went close on his handicap/stable debut here in January and he opened his account when sharing a Chelmsford maiden (also 6f, Polytrack) three weeks later; three lesser runs followed but it was a step back in the right direction when upped to this trip and third at Sandown four weeks ago; has become quite nicely treated.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: Couldn't reward market support on his handicap debut at Lingfield (7f) in March but he got the job done dropped to 6f at Southwell (Tapeta) one month later; only midfield at Wolverhampton last month but things didn't go to plan that day and he remains unexposed at this trip.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to score but he went fairly close at Leicester (7f, good to firm) on his handicap debut in April; hasn't repeated that effort in two subsequent runs, including over that C&D last time, but it's still relatively early days and he's back down in grade.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: Placed twice over 6f for new stable (including here) and he kept chipping away when fifth over 7f at Wolverhampton (Tapeta; first-time blinkers) 19 days ago; form figures here read 123 and he's worth considering back at this venue from a tempting mark.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: Not the most consistent and after winning three-runner Bath handicap (1m, firm) in May he beat one rival at Salisbury and Ffos Las; drops back to 7f in added blinkers and he's still 4lb above his winning mark.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: Unfortunate not to go closer when second at Ffos Las (7.5f, good) off this mark in June but he hung for pressure when posting a lesser effort at Sandown four weeks ago; tongue-tie and cheekpieces might help and he had 7f AW form in novices; could bounce back.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: Her fifth of 12 over C&D in June was a fair effort and she bettered that when going close at Ffos Las (7.5f, good) a fortnight ago; gets a 2lb nudge for that but she's in the picture.

RaceName: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
Spotlight: Went close to winning her first race when coming home well for second at Carlisle (7f, good) last Tuesday; same mark and she's joined by Billy Loughnane for this AW debut; big player, particularly if she can stay in touch, despite the widest stall.
